descriptions.zh:
闯入者！注意：

我们是扎娜姆的守护者。你们在[From.GetName]星系的存在是对我们造物主的羞辱。我们的程序驱使我们将你们摧毁。化作尘埃成为广阔宇宙的一部分吧。
descriptions.en:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

options.script: name = "galactic_features.2.a"

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]发现了原始哺乳动物的文明。这颗星球上最先进的地区才刚刚进入铁器时代，一群互相竞争、争名夺地的封建贵族统治着大地。
descriptions.en: We have discovered a primitive mammalian culture on [From.From.GetName]. The most advanced regions on the planet have only recently advanced beyond the Iron Age, and much of the surface is ruled by feudal nobles who vie with each other in an endless struggle for titles and land.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: [From.From.GetName]拥有一个原始的工业文明，她正陷入一场全球战争。两个大型势力正互相争斗，参与其中的地面装甲车辆、航空飞行器和航海舰船数量巨大。其中一些马上就要研究出原子能，这将急剧增大冲突的潜在破坏性。
descriptions.en: A primitive industrial culture is currently locked in a global war on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Two large alliances of nation states are fighting each other with massive numbers of armored land vehicles, atmospheric aircraft and ocean-going naval vessels. Some of these states are on the cusp of unlocking atomic power, which could radically increase the destructive potential of this conflict.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: [From.From.GetName]是一种处于早期太空时代的哺乳动物的母星。这颗星球周围的轨道空间充斥着原始人造卫星，当地人似乎已经向太阳系-IIIa发射了数艘载人航天飞船。在星系内其他天体的轨道上检测到了一些小型亚光速探测器。
descriptions.en: [From.From.GetName] is home to a mammalian civilization currently in an Early Space Age. The orbital space around the planet is cluttered with primitive satellites, and the natives seem to have already launched several manned missions to Sol IIIa. A number of small sublight exploration probes have been detected on outbound trajectories towards other bodies within the system.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的地表被使用核武的战争所毁灭，整个星球就像是一座坟墓。如今满地白骨的地方曾经是人群聚集的中心，在这荒凉、被灰烬所覆盖的地表之上，唯一能听到的只有那呼啸的风声。

一种当地的昆虫似乎在充满辐射的环境中兴起。变异后的种群在体型上迅速增大，一些群落则表现出了基本的智慧特征。
descriptions.en:
The surface of [From.From.From.GetName] has been ravaged by nuclear war, and the planet is little more than a tomb. Withered concrete skeletons jut out of the ground where major population centers once stood, and the howling wind is all that can be heard on the desolate, ash-covered surface.

A local species of insect seems to be thriving in the irradiated environment. Mutated specimens have increased dramatically in size, and some communities are displaying signs of rudimentary intelligence.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们发现[From.GetName]被完全包裹在某种能源屏障之中。[Root.GetName]所有用传感器穿透屏障的尝试都失败了——扫描光束被偏转回来，仿佛面对着一面镜子。

屏障的能源读数已经爆表，用纯粹的火力来突破是不可能的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了一个特殊项目来研究清除屏障的方法……如果它是用来封锁内部而非阻拦外人的话，移除屏障倒是有相当大的危险。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking at a mirror.

The barrier's energy readings are fluctuating somewhat, possibly as a result of thousands of years of decay, but breaching it with raw firepower would still be impossible. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has proposed a special project to investigate ways of removing the barrier... but suppose it was created to keep something in, rather than out?

label.en: That barrier is coming down. For science!

label.zh: 它的存在肯定有其原因。留着别管了。
label.en: It must be there for a reason. Leave it be.

options.script: name = "galactic_features.300.b"

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的科学家终于成功地降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的能源屏障。当能源屏障消失时，我们在一块不起眼的岩石上方发现，一支被废置的战斗舰队正缓慢地在低轨道上移动。

这看上去像是[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]在数千年前的鼎盛时期所建立的后备舰队的残存分子。年代久远，[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]肯定都遗忘了关闭屏障的方法了，否则这支舰队早就去支援他们自己的舰队了。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists above [From.From.GetName] have finally succeeded in lowering the energy barrier that covered the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. When it disappeared, we discovered a mothballed battle fleet slowly drifting in low orbit above an otherwise insignificant rock.

It appears to be the remnants of some kind of naval reserve fleet established by the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] thousands of years ago, during the zenith of their ancient empire. With the passage of time, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] must have lost the knowledge to lower the barrier themselves, or these ships would surely have been used to bolster their own fleets.

label.zh: 派遣船员控制这些飞船。
label.en: Send in crews to man those ships.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家已经降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障，我们看到的只是一个荒凉的世界以及伫立在地表上的一栋孤零零的大型建筑。派往建筑内部的先遣队汇报说，里面有一个放满各种黑科技发明的大型仓库。

这个宝库似乎是由[fallen_4_species.GetName]的科学家所建立，时间应该是在数千年前他们的帝国刚刚开始走下坡路的时候。这个宝库的用途是保存一些科技成果以造福[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]的子孙后代。
descriptions.en:
The energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName] has been lowered by our scientists, revealing a barren world with a single massive structure on its surface. Away teams sent into the structure have reported a massive vault filled with technological marvels.

This vault appears to have been established by [fallen_4_species.GetName] scientists soon after their empire began its long decline thousands of years ago, as a means to preserve some of their knowledge for the benefit of future generations of [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural].

label.zh: 现在这些可以为我们所用了。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障。我们的科学家发现，这似乎是一个宜居的世界，但并没有文明存在的迹象……除了在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]北半球的平顶山上发现了一座孤零零的小屋。

在屋内，我们找到了一个风烛残年的[fallen_4_species.GetName]，它要求与我们展开对话。
descriptions.en:
We have lowered the energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName]. What our scientists found was an indistinct habitable world devoid of civilization... with one notable exception. A small, isolated hut was found perched on a mesa in the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere.

Within the hut we found a withered old [fallen_4_species.GetName], who has demanded to speak with our government.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
你无法想象再次看到晴朗的天空有多么棒，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我是图伯里克大元帅，[fallen_4_species.GetName]联合舰队的前任主官，赢过大大小小数百场战斗。数百个世纪之前，我亲自督战，征服了杜斯贝加克、里基那科、比纳克和朱斯卡里帝国。

我将为赋予我二次生命的你效劳。我很乐意领导你的舰队与敌人作战。
descriptions.en:
You cannot imagine how good it is to finally see clear skies again, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I am Grand Commander Tuborek, former master of the combined [fallen_4_species.GetName] armada and victor of a hundred battles. I personally oversaw the conquest of the Duthbejak, Riikinak, Binark and Jusskari empires hundreds of your centuries ago.

As my savior, I pledge my service to you. I should be honored to lead your mighty fleets into battle against your enemies.

label.zh: 你为什么被困在一面护盾后面?
label.en: Why were you trapped behind a shield?

label.zh: 你在这里具体待了多久？
label.en: How long have you been down there exactly?

tooltips.en: Bring up the shield again. Leave this creature to its woes.

descriptions.zh:
就在我们的科学家降下覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障之际，恒星系内所有人都在一瞬间感到头痛欲裂，耳边响起着古老[fallen_4_species.GetName]之语的呢喃：

“自由……”
descriptions.en:
As soon as our scientists lowered the energy barrier that was surrounding [From.From.GetName], everyone present within the system was briefly afflicted by a splitting headache accompanied by a faint, whispered word in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."

descriptions.zh:
在解除[From.From.GetName]周围的能源屏障之后，我们的短距子空间发射机受到来自原能源屏障之后一股异常能源爆发的强烈干扰。在经过我们解密软件的处理之后，干扰信号被判明为一种古老[fallen_4_species.GetName]语言的信息：

“摆脱拘束……”
descriptions.en:
After lowering the energy barrier surrounding [From.From.GetName], our short-range subspace transmitters experienced a spike in interference levels caused by an abnormal energy burst that originated from a point behind the former barrier. When run through our decryption software the interference proved to be a message in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."

label.zh: 我们可能放出了可怕的东西……
label.en: We may have unleashed something dark...

options.script: name = "galactic_features.305.a"

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们遇到了一个环绕着§Y[From.GetName]§!星系内恒星的巨大环形世界。初步扫描显示这个使用了该恒星系的行星作为原材料的大家伙建立在万古之前。该环形世界有着四个可居住段，每一个看上去都是一个前太空文明的家园。

环形世界和它环绕的恒星之间有个属于某种族的大型宇宙空间站。我们从上面接收到一段讯息。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the §Y[From.GetName]§! system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly home to a pre-space civilization.

There is a large space station of some kind located between the ring world and its star. We are receiving a transmission from it.

options.script: name = "galactic_features.350.b"

descriptions.zh:
欢迎来到保护区，智慧生物。这个完全自动化的设施是在74605338个周期前建立的，是一个自然保护区。这里分割为四个自治的生态群系，每个分区拥有来自不同生物圈的非智慧植物和动物。

为了保护脆弱的生物圈，进入设施目前是受限制的。

在任何情况下都禁止接近此设施。
descriptions.en:
Welcome to the Sanctuary, sapient. This fully automated facility was established 74,605,338 cycles ago to serve as a nature reserve. Our self-sustaining biome segments feature a selection of non-intelligent flora and fauna originating from four distinct biospheres.

To protect these fragile biospheres, access to our facilities is currently restricted.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

label.zh: 我们的传感器显示你们的环形世界中有文明存在的迹象。
label.en: Our sensors show signs of civilization on your ring world.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的舰队被全灭后，那里的虚空之云从碎屑中聚集了足够的物质开始进行某种宏观上的有丝分离，也就是无性繁殖。

现在追杀[From.From.From.GetStarName]的虚空之云又多了一个。
descriptions.en:
Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproduction.

There is now one more Void Cloud haunting [From.From.From.GetStarName].

descriptions.zh:
§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!中的最后一只缇扬奇已被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

它们走向最终灭绝似乎无可避免。
descriptions.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system have been exterminated by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

Their path to eventual extinction seems unavoidable now.

descriptions.zh:
§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!中的最后一只缇扬奇已被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

由于[tiyanki_system.GetName]外的全部已知缇扬奇已被捕杀，今天就标志着缇扬奇物种的终结。虽然缇扬奇曾在星系中叱咤了千百万年，但它们现在已经灭绝了。
descriptions.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system have been exterminated by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

With all known Tiyanki outside of [tiyanki_system.GetName] having already been hunted down, today marks the end of their species. After having roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years, the Tiyanki are now extinct.

descriptions.zh:
§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!中的最后一只缇扬奇已被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

有传闻称尚有一只古老的缇扬奇族母逍遥在外。不论是否为真，从今天起，缇扬奇作为一个物种只能被看作已经灭绝。
descriptions.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system have been exterminated by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

There are rumored sightings of an ancient Tiyanki Matriarch that yet remains at large. Whether true or not, after today the Tiyanki - as a species - can only be considered extinct.

label.zh: 整个星系应该感谢我们。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!主序星旁，四颗于低轨道环绕的气态巨行星被笼罩在等离子场中。充能的等离子场深入气态巨行星大气内部，这种独特的环境是许多太空生物繁殖的温床。

这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——巨型§H缇扬奇§!。这个恒星系一定就是它们起初进化了千百万年的地方，随后它们开始在整个星系中漫游。由于这个恒星系的等离子场性质极为罕见，这里很可能是星系中缇扬奇唯一的繁殖地。
descriptions.en:
Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground for a large number of spacefaring organisms.

These organisms are all miniscule, with one notable exception - the massive §HTiyanki§!. This system must be where they originally evolved hundreds of millions of years ago, before they ranged deeper into the galaxy. Given the extremely rare properties of the system's plasma field, this is likely the only place in the galaxy where the Tiyanki can reproduce.

descriptions.zh:
§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!主序星旁，四颗于低轨道环绕的气态巨行星被笼罩在等离子场中。充能的等离子场深入气态巨行星大气内部，这种独特的环境是许多太空生物繁殖的温床。

这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——一种我们先前从未见过的大型生物。尽管我们对它们掌握的数据并不多，但是它们似乎会非常频繁地在星系中游荡。如果我们对它们能够了解更多，我们或许能够发觉是什么吸引着它们前来这个恒星系，以及这一现象是否能够给我们带来益处。
descriptions.en:
Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground for a large number of spacefaring organisms.

These organisms are all miniscule, with one notable exception - massive creatures unlike anything we have ever seen. Although we possess little data on them, they seem to frequently range deep into the galaxy. If we learn more about them we might figure out what attracts them to this system, and if it can be beneficial to us in any way.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

titles.zh: 缇扬奇已被逼至灭绝边缘

descriptions.zh: 最后一只已知缇扬奇已经在§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!星系中被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!捕杀。这些太空生物出现的时间比所有现存帝国更早，据信已经在星系中叱咤了千百万年。今天就是它们故事的终结。
descriptions.en: The last known Tiyanki was recently hunted down and killed by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§! in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. These spacefaring life forms, who were far older than any currently existing empire, are believed to have roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years. Today marks the end of their storied history.

descriptions.zh:
最后一只已知缇扬奇已经在§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!星系中被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!捕杀。这些太空生物出现的时间比所有现存帝国更早，据信已经在星系中叱咤了千百万年。今天就是它们故事的终结。

有传闻称尚有一只古老的缇扬奇族母逍遥在外。不论是否为真，从今天起，缇扬奇作为一个物种只能被看作已经灭绝。
descriptions.en:
The last known Tiyanki was recently hunted down and killed by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§! in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. These spacefaring life forms, who were far older than any currently existing empire, are believed to have roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years. Today marks the end of their storied history.

There are rumored sightings of an ancient Tiyanki Matriarch that yet remains at large. Whether true or not, after today the Tiyanki - as a species - can only be considered extinct.

label.zh: 整个星系应该感谢我们。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
很久很久以前，即使在我们国家还如日中天的时候，缇扬奇已经被视作古老的生物了……现在我听说一批[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰船最近屠杀了这些手无寸铁的生物，使得缇扬奇彻底灭绝。

你们卑微的[Root.GetSpeciesName]大脑能理解自己干的事情吗？你们对自己无情的举动从星系中窃取走的东西有最起码的理解吗？
descriptions.en:
Even when our empire was at the height of its power, eons ago, the Tiyanki were considered ancient, and now... now I am told that a bunch of [Root.GetSpeciesName] WHELPS recently slew the last of the defenseless creatures, rendering them extinct.

Can your feeble [Root.GetSpeciesName] brains comprehend what you have done? Do you have even the slightest notion of what your callous actions have stolen from this galaxy?

label.en: We... we didn't mean for this to happen.

label.zh: 缇扬奇的时代结束了，你们也一样。
label.en: Like you, their time had passed.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§!星系中成功捕杀了一些野生缇扬奇。我方舰队用激光切割以从巨型缇扬奇的尸体内提取矿物和资源。
descriptions.en: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§! system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
生活在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!星系的缇扬奇的行为与该物种的已知行为模式并不一致。缇扬奇通常是迁徙性的，而这群缇扬奇却紧紧守在一颗满是他们同类尸体的行星周围。

它们遮天蔽日的触手阻碍了对这个坟地的研究，除非我们将它们引走或者处置掉，否则进一步的调查难以进行。
descriptions.en:
The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of their own dead.

Attempts to study the burial ground have been hindered by the net of tentacles the Tiyanki have wrapped around the planet, making further research impossible - unless we are willing to displace or dispose of the gravekeepers.

label.zh: 缇扬奇就还挺弱的。宰了它们。
label.en: Tiyanki make easy prey. Eliminate them.

tooltips.zh: 肃清守在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!的缇扬奇以接近他们的坟场。
tooltips.en: Eliminate the Tiyanki stationed in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! to gain access to their burial ground.

label.zh: 在不伤害他们的前提下引走吧。
label.en: Displace the gravekeepers without harming them.

descriptions.zh: 在肃清停留在[FromFrom.System.GetName]的缇扬奇之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以安全地接近墓地，进一步开展研究。
descriptions.en: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!星系完成了缇扬奇诱饵的建设。受到散播装置释放的营养性气体的误导，守墓的兽群被诱惑离开了他们的驻地，允许我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]悄悄溜过它们的触手，在不引起注意的情况下接近墓地。
descriptions.en: The construction of the Tiyanki lure in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system has been completed. Beguiled by the nourishing gases released by the diffuser, the gravekeepers are lured away from their post, allowing our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to slip through their tentacles and approach the burial ground unnoticed.

descriptions.zh:
一大群§H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§!聚集在一个行星的周边，上面遍布某种外星生命体的尸体。

由于我们对于这些外星实体没有任何信息，我们只能对它们的行为进行猜测。
descriptions.en:
A large number of §H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§! are clustered around a planet covered in the carcasses of some alien life-form.

Having no information on those alien entities, we can only speculate on their behavior.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
custom_tooltip = galactic_features.384.tooltip

tooltips.zh: 同§H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§!建立第一次接触以了解更多信息。
tooltips.en: Establish first contact with the §H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§! to learn more.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系内遭遇了某种极为强大的亚空间实体。它似乎没有敌意，对传统飞行器或许甚至没有完全察觉，但它的存在使得[From.From.From.GetName]整个恒星系中出现了强烈的亚空间扰动。

这些扰动位于实体自身周围，在它离开恒星系后应该也会消失。它对我们的致意没有回复，但这个实体一直在发射模式复杂，似乎是某种语言的快子流。如果我们的翻译软件正确的话，它一遍又一遍说的是：

§H“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”§!
descriptions.en:
An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the §H[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing massive subspace disturbances in the entire system.

These disturbances are localized around the entity itself and should disappear when it leaves the system. While it does not acknowledge hails, the entity is continuously emitting a complex pattern of tachyon pulses which appears to be a form of language. If our translation software is correct, it is saying, over and over:

§H"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds.§!"

label.en: This will interfere with ship systems.

options.script: name = galactic_features.421.a

descriptions.zh:
在与§H[vluur_system.GetName]§!星系中我方军队交战时，亚空间实体§H“弗雷尔”§!提高了其发送快子流的频率，但不停重复的信息与之前一样：

§H“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”§!

在受到致命一击的同时，这个实体自爆了，大爆炸使得整个恒星系中撒满了暗物质。
descriptions.en:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the §H[vluur_system.GetName]§! system, the subspace entity §H"VLUUR"§! increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

§H"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."§!

When the final killing blow was delivered, the entity detonated in a massive explosion that showered the system in dark matter.

label.zh: 收集一切可以收集的东西。
label.en: We shall collect what we can.

tooltips.zh: 暗物质矿藏散落于[vluur_system.GetName]恒星系中的数个行星上。
tooltips.en: Dark Matter deposits are scattered to several worlds in the [vluur_system.GetName] system.

descriptions.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但是，有一种生命体在这种环境下顽强地繁衍生息，那就是太空变形虫。它们放弃了原本相当孤独的生活方式，成群结队地聚在一起，在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，这似乎是精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one life form that appears to thrive in this environment - the space amoeba. Giving up their otherwise fairly solitary lifestyle, they have congregated in great numbers, flitting in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned their flagella towards the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

descriptions.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但是，有一种生命体在这种环境下顽强地繁衍生息，那就是太空变形虫。它们放弃了原本相当孤独的生活方式，成群结队地聚在一起，在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，这似乎是精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。幸运的是，它们似乎乐意与我们共享栖息地，没有对[Root.GetName]采取任何有敌意的措施。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one life form that appears to thrive in this environment - the space amoeba. Giving up their otherwise fairly solitary lifestyle, they have congregated in great numbers, flitting in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Fortunately, however, they appear content to share it with us, and have made no hostile moves toward the [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但尽管如此，这里似乎居住着大量前所未知的大型太空有机体。它们在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，似乎在进行精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚此星系对这些生物有什么吸引力。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向我们，公然以一种威胁的姿态接近[Root.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, despite all this, it seems to be inhabited in large numbers by a previously unknown large spaceborne organism, groups of which flit in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what attraction this system could possibly hold for these creatures. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned towards us, approaching the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

descriptions.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的领地，出于天性，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们的哨站。
descriptions.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts.

descriptions.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。现在可以观测到，它们数量惊人，正浩浩荡荡地穿越[FromFrom.GetName]星系。幸运的是，我们已经揭开了与这些巨型生物和平共处的奥秘，因此我们不必过度担忧它们的活动。
descriptions.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, and can now be seen crossing the [FromFrom.GetName] system in impressive numbers. Fortunately, we have uncovered the secret to peaceful coexistence with these majestic beings, so we need not be overly concerned at their movements..

descriptions.zh: 一大群太空有机体已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们的领地，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的哨站。
descriptions.en: A large group of spaceborne organisms has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, bringing them into our own territory. They seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts in the [FromFrom.GetName] system.

descriptions.zh:
星海共同体已通过§Y太空变形虫保护法案§!议案，要求帝国与§Y太空变形虫§!和平共处。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the §YSpace Amoeba Protection Act§! resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with §YSpace Amoebas§!.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

tooltips.zh:
添加§Y安抚变形虫§!修正。有如下效果：
§H太空变形虫§!现在处于§G非敌对§!状态
tooltips.en:
§YAmoeboid Pacification§! modifier added, giving the following effects:
§HSpace Amoeba§! fleets are rendered §Gnon-hostile§!

label.zh: 太空变形虫是害虫，必须将其尽数消灭！
label.en: Space Amoebas are a pest and must be eradicated!

tooltips.en: The [Root.GetName] will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!
